page.overview:
Who is Donald Ferguson?

Debbie Grayson Invincible Guardians of the Globe Brit (close friend)

Flaxancible † Lightblueincible † (possible attempted killer)

Donald Ferguson is a major character in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards.

He is Cecil Stedman's assistant, the Guardians of the Globe's contact, and an agent of the Global Defense Agency. Originally, he was human before being turned into an android after repeatedly dying and being revived by the G.D.A. as he continued to work with them.
